Usage: gacli report cohort [options]

Run a GA4 cohort report

Options:
  -m, --metrics <metrics...>          Metrics to include in the report
  --cohorts <json>                    Cohort definitions as a JSON string
  --cohort-granularity <granularity>  Cohort granularity: DAILY, WEEKLY, or
                                      MONTHLY
  --end-offset <number>               End offset for the cohort report
  --start-offset <number>             Start offset for the cohort report
  -d, --dimensions <dimensions...>    Dimensions to include in the report
  --accumulate                        Accumulate cohort data over time
  -h, --help                          display help for command
